title: The Hush That Comes With Snow
core_idea: Fresh snow softens sound and makes the world quieter; we can borrow that hush by letting a few moments of the day be muffled and still.
text: Have you ever stepped outside after a fresh snowfall and noticed how quiet everything becomes? Snow softens sound. Footsteps grow muffled. Traffic seems farther away. Even your own breathing sounds closer. Nothing was switched off, and yet the whole world feels gentler. There is something in us that recognizes that hush. Maybe because so much of life is loud: notifications, opinions, the constant hum of things to do. You don't need snow to find it. You can let a few minutes fall softly over your day. Put the phone in another room. Listen to the small sounds that remain. Let the edges of the world grow soft, the way snow does.
description: A quiet reflection on the hush that fresh snow brings, and how we might let a little of that softness into our day.
